title: Fix reports are moved by hand: author gives message only
what: Brief the author to write its report to a given path; align the author definition and the spec-review skill on triage; add a Wave line check to kit packet --check.
why: The spec-review checker line wants 'Fixes: <author report>' as a path, but sdd:author replies only by message and said it wrote no triage file; the coordinator saves hand-backs as files itself. Also kit packet --check does not check the Wave line that parallel-apply needs, so the first author omitted it and only the reviewer caught it.
failing_case: Trial: the author said 'I wrote no triage file because the brief asked for fixes only'; the coordinator saved the report as spec-fix-report.md; F2 (no Wave 1 line) passed openspec validate --strict, kit spec-check and kit packet --check.
pass_cases: The spec-review skill passes a report path to the author and the file exists afterwards; kit packet --check reports a tasks.md with no Wave line when the tasks run in waves.
